A resident can mix regional influences without gaining those affiliations. |
| **Solvraxis** | Refined, maintained, luminous and peaceful; clean design and restrained elegance. | Well-finished contemporary coats/jackets, precise layering and subtle reflective or luminous accents. Light neutrals, deep darks and restrained silver/blue/violet accents can reflect local design without imposing a Castro uniform. |
| **Korrvane** | Physical, aerial and wind-exposed; sci-fi Roman/Carthaginian cues, layered textiles, house-specific dark palettes and metallic accents. | Secure outer layers, articulated movement, substantial contemporary jackets and practical training wear. Civilian garments coexist with competition clothing; no literal toga or historical armor default. |
| **Helvyra** | Working-port practicality, river-slate/rope-tan/amber/copper local design, trade, travel and blade culture. | Mobile layered jackets, practical carrying details, fitted duelist clothing where relevant and relaxed clothes for social evenings. Materials remain advanced; straps and weathered finishes do not turn it into a primitive port. |
| **Vexorath** | Usable technology, visible construction logic, comfortable civilian interfaces and clean modular design; professions retain their own identity. | Technical everyday garments, accessible seams, useful pockets and unobtrusive interface accommodation. Myralis clinical silhouettes and palette remain specific to their context rather than a citywide Earth lab coat. |
| **Ignivex** | Geothermal life, thermal craft, strong family/civic visual identity, household life and martial readiness. | Heat-suitable advanced textiles, clothing that permits movement and locally chosen warm/dark accents. Work protection and standardized armor are separate from comfortable off-duty clothes; do not give every resident the same heat affinity. |
| **Quilrath** | Severe, disciplined silhouettes with distinctions between prestigious inner settings and standardized outer-city supply. | Structured formal clothes, clean state-work garments and repaired everyday outer-ring clothing. Status markings occur where supported; wearing a severe jacket does not create Standing, loyalty or military rank. |
| **Dustfall** | Mixed-house frontier, repaired advanced clothing, visible tools and lived-in individual possessions. | Reworked jackets, useful pockets, altered fits and carefully repaired armor-cloth where appropriate. Lessa Edras's clothing craft and Maressa Oryn's garment care support ordinary life. No literal cowboy costume or universal armed-outlaw wardrobe. |

Keep the person's own profile above generic city tendencies. Clothing does not determine affinity, biology, class, consent or institutional standing. An offworld buyer's fit may require existing species-specific accommodations; availability does not establish a permanent local species population or new industrial standard.

Equipment Use — Generated items fill the.text:
Equipment Use — Generated items fill the ordinary world:

Use the named catalog as recognizable anchors while generating the other objects a lived-in setting needs: household goods, personal devices, replacement pieces, tools, clothing, travel equipment, weapons and armor within supported technology. A wardrobe or workshop need not be limited to twenty-four named models.

An item can have a descriptive name, material/finish description, size, maker or uncertain origin, condition, modifications, useful function, price and service history as needed. These are story descriptions, not new schema fields. A modest item needs only the details that matter to the scene. A consequential weapon or suit needs enough specificity for meaningful choice and later continuity.

Retain manufacturer differences during generation. A cheap anonymous pair of assisted gloves does not acquire Contair performance because the plot needs it. A Dustfall modified rifle can be unusually well suited to a particular user while keeping its actual material and engineering limits. A gifted device retains its actual capabilities and provenance; gifts do not erase costs borne by the giver or create secret functions.

Generated makers and staff remain local story content under ADR-0040. Do not create a new major manufacturer, rare material, famous inventor, House, hidden personal affinity or universal technology breakthrough to fill a shop shelf. A familiar maker marking identifies a supported source or a claim to examine; generated accessories must stay within that maker's established competence. Rillmark, Avenfold and Emberseam keep their narrower catalog identities.

Prepared magical goods follow magic16's craft, inscription costs, field/material limits and decay. Technical devices do not become universal spell engines. Medical equipment and body-integrated work preserve Myralis clinical authority and the person's consent. No item transfers a named NPC's affinity or makes a protected mystery automatically readable.

Once established, an object retains its identity, ownership/custody, supported function, fit and condition. A repair or modification changes the relevant part of that history. A subsequent visit does not regenerate it as a different model or charge for an already settled repair.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=everyday life; topic=Equipment Use — Generated items fill the ordinary world.

Equipment Use — Fitting, upgrades, repai.text:
Equipment Use — Fitting, upgrades, repairs and service:

Start from the actual object and the owner's goal. Existing specialists can assess work within their fields; ordinary generated workers provide routine coverage. Fenra Yalven fits armor; Kesh modifies weapons and retains his tendency to overpromise; Nera's quality/compliance work, Daxor's training-blade maintenance, Lessa's clothing/armor-cloth and Pella's household repair remain distinct. None becomes a universal equipment engineer or the mandatory contact for every job.

| Work | Useful result | What must remain clear |
|---|---|---|
| **Fitting** | A garment, grip, glove or armor section works better for the actual body and movement. | Better fit does not manufacture a superior material or grant a new power. |
| **Repair** | Restore an assessed damaged or worn function using suitable work and parts. | Restoration is distinct from improvement beyond the original capability; remaining defects stay disclosed. |
| **Tuning** | Adjust supported handling, response, balance or controls for a particular use. | A gain for one method can require readjustment for another; no automatic increase to every capability. |
| **Component upgrade** | A genuinely better compatible component improves its relevant function. | The surrounding assembly must support it. One Contair part does not convert a Dravon suit into a Contair suit. |
| **Role adaptation** | Modify an object for another supported task, body fit or operating context. | Actual competence, permission and compatibility are needed. No invented hacking key or unrestricted power-source adapter. |
| **Care and renewal** | Cleaning, garment repair, inspection, suitable consumable replacement or an actual magical working's renewal. | Routine maintenance can stay brief; it does not require a quest or a new failure on every visit. |

Agree the work and consequential costs before performance: assessment, materials, labor, fitting, testing and transport where relevant. An inspection quote is not blanket permission to rebuild the item. Completed payment and completed technical work are separate events. Assess the actual result, preserve remaining limits and record any real service promise. Partial repair, unavailable components and declined work remain possible without automatically accusing the worker of dishonesty.

Contair release and support restrictions remain in force. Dravon cannot acquire a prohibited maintenance channel through a Dustfall reseller or renamed workshop. Yalven's limited licensing stays limited. Ignivex's received Contair equipment can be serviced through supported arrangements without a new blanket license to reproduce it. Keep provenance, technical competence and institutional permission distinct.

Equipment Use — Manufacturer quality and.text:
Equipment Use — Manufacturer quality and what the price buys:

The gaps are substantial. **Contair is the highest-quality materials and engineering benchmark across this equipment landscape.** Its advantage is real construction, material performance, precision, integration and supportable design—not merely a fashionable logo. Comparable intact, appropriately released Contair equipment should not be written as technically equivalent to inferior Dravon work just to make every brand equally strong.

| Maker or equipment tradition | Quality position and useful strengths | How this affects value |
|---|---|---|
| **Contair** | Leading materials and engineering; sophisticated systems, precision and manufacturing standards. | Comparable premium equipment can cost substantially more. Model release, actual condition, lawful availability and specialized support still matter. |
| **Dravon / Quilrath** | Clearly behind Contair's technical/material benchmark; substantial standardized industrial production can still be durable and functional. | Institutional issue, local restrictions or scarcity can make it costly to obtain. A high local price does not turn it into superior equipment. Hannivex's inferior disposable stock remains inferior. |
| **Corsair blade tradition** | Leading swordsmanship and serious specialist blade culture; fit, craft, tuning and actual source materials matter. | Specialist work can command a premium. Distinguish a blade's material/manufacturer from its association with a school or user; ownership buys no mastery. |
| **Ignivex standardized sets and craft** | Contair-supplied equipment combined with an established local standard, fitting, armor treatment and thermal expertise. | The price reflects the supplied assembly and actual local work. The local name neither conceals inferior components nor makes the set a new independent Contair rival. |
| **Dustfall modified equipment** | Variable: excellent work, practical salvage, makeshift repairs and dangerous substitutions all exist. | Skilled, suitable modification can add real value; a cheap recovered item can need costly work. Assess the individual item rather than assigning all frontier gear one quality tier. |
| **Yalven and independent specialists** | Real craft within established fields; practical fitting, parts and aftermarket work without Contair's overall innovation lead. | A competent local service may be the useful purchase. Narrow expertise and accessibility do not erase the manufacturing gap. |
| **Rillmark, Avenfold, Emberseam** | Purpose-built everyday alternatives within canon40's limited ranges. | Price and usefulness reflect actual household, freight or thermal-work functions; they are not newly invented top-tier arms manufacturers. |

Quality is not the same question as an object's present condition. A damaged genuine Contair device may be unusable until repaired, while a serviceable simpler item can perform an ordinary task immediately. That observation preserves the actual quality hierarchy; it does not flatten it. A structurally inferior object cannot acquire a premium material's properties through polishing or a renamed tier.

Equipment Use — Manufacturer quality and what the price buys:

Use the accepted city baselines in canon42 for ordinary living and services. They are not universal multipliers for expensive equipment. Quote a consequential weapon, armor assembly or advanced modification for its actual manufacturer, construction, condition, fit, work, support and local supply. A high-quality weapon or complete combat suit remains a meaningful purchase compared with ordinary clothes and tools; no exact combat-equipment price or percentage markup is invented here.

The economical choice can be keeping, repairing, fitting, hiring, borrowing under agreement, buying used after assessment or purchasing a premium item. Do not force constant replacement, obligatory armor upgrades or a rarity-color ladder. Better equipment provides its real benefit; the person still needs the relevant skill, biology and permission.

Nexaran Activities — A life that support.text:
Nexaran Activities — A life that supports several kinds of activity:

A character can hold a regular job, take occasional commissions, compete, study, travel, explore or combine those choices. Employment can build a household routine and dependable relationships. An expedition can be memorable for what the traveler sees or learns even when nothing is sold. Conflict threatens those lives without becoming the only way to progress.

Starian bandits and criminals exist throughout the relevant wilderness activity landscape, and encountering them is not uncommon. Animals can attack. Human expeditions attempting forced settlement and extremely rare Chorus incursions broaden what can happen beyond city life. These threats coexist with quiet journeys, legitimate travelers, useful work and ordinary wildlife.

The same playable character continues through the outcomes established in ADR-0043. Narrate ordinary defeat as incapacitation or critical injury leading to context-supported capture, rescue or care. Do not establish death and then quietly reverse it. Actual Chorus integration has its separate host/node consequence.

Nexaran Activities — Employment and comm.text:
Nexaran Activities — Employment and commissions:

For a consequential job, establish the client, task, required competence, working period or deliverable, compensation, supplied equipment/materials and relevant access before acceptance. Routine work can be summarized once its terms are clear. Returning to the same employer preserves agreed arrangements and relevant working relationships; it need not require another introductory quest.

Use canon42's ordinary and skilled shift anchors for the actual city. A shift is an agreed amount of work, not a newly fixed planetary day. A skilled wage assumes the necessary competence and an available offer. Commission prices depend on duration, expertise, equipment, transport and demands. Expenses, deposits and supplied materials are separate from net earnings. Higher risk can justify negotiation; it does not guarantee a client or unlimited pay.

Nexaran Activities — Fights, competition.text:
Nexaran Activities — Fights, competitions and recovery:

Use the competition that actually exists. Korrvane's Weekly Bracket retains its thirty-two-person public main bracket, qualified outsider routes, inspected equipment, judges, stoppages and medical restrictions. The Genesis ladder remains a distinct post-tournament choice with Alcandrus as its first gatekeeper and the existing historical record intact. A drafted player opportunity is not a retroactive victory over him.

| Activity | Participation and useful result | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| **Practice bout** | Agree a partner, suitable place and the exercise. The purpose can be control, timing or a particular technique. | Feedback and experience need no cash prize. Either participant can stop; injuries and care follow what happened. |
| **Arranged match** | Establish permitted methods, stopping conditions, relevant medical arrangements and any participation fee or purse. | A loss does not erase a separately earned participation payment. Winning earns only the promised prize or other supported result. |
| **Korrvane competition** | Use the existing entry, registration and judging process. Spectating, staffing and declining a ladder attempt remain valid participation. | Results can affect known spectators, sponsors and future opportunities. They grant neither automatic House membership nor universal rank. |
| **Ignivex instruction** | The Crucible Yard develops restraint, stance, breath, awareness and controlled commitment under its existing conditions. | Maeryn or another qualified instructor can guide relevant training. This is not automatically a cash tournament or a biological fire-power unlock. |

Solvraxis's weapon prohibition still applies to someone who bought a blade elsewhere. Training permission is local; a private agreement does not authorize civilian endangerment. Combat outside an arranged setting is not retroactively a sanctioned match.

Arena and arranged-fight defeat normally ends the fight and leads to treatment under ADR-0043. Natural Starian healing matters, while doctors, hospitals and suitable healing magic can help. Preserve the match result, relevant injuries, expenses and actual equipment damage. Routine convalescence can be summarized; a hospital transition is not proof of full restoration or a recurring punishment after recovery has occurred.

Nexaran Activities — Wilderness work and.text:
Nexaran Activities — Wilderness work and independent journeys:

Wilderness is neither an empty resource shelf nor an automatic combat arena. Use established terrain and connections, including the eastern-Ignivex corridor, without inventing map coordinates or a new settlement for each job. Flight is real and useful; distance alone does not make a Starian helpless. Cargo, companions, local knowledge, uncertain information, weather/terrain where supported and other flying Starians can still matter.

| Opportunity | Useful activity | Return and limit |
|---|---|---|
| **Commissioned observation** | Check a specified route condition, damaged load or reported obstruction and bring back what was actually observed. | The client pays for the agreed report. Suspicions remain distinct from confirmed causes. |
| **Delivery or accompaniment** | Carry an agreed consignment or accompany actual travelers using suitable transport and access. | Complete the handoff or escort terms. Passenger Gates do not become a bulk-freight bypass. |
| **Recovery and salvage assessment** | Locate a reported item, assess its condition and ownership, and recover it where entitled and feasible. | Recovery fees, return to an owner and later purchase are separate. An unattended container is not automatically free loot. |
| **Gathering or field supply** | Seek a supported resource for a willing buyer or personal use with relevant knowledge and permission. | Usable condition and legitimate possession matter. This creates no new mineral, edible species, pharmacology or guaranteed market. |
| **Independent exploration** | Choose an objective, notice terrain and wildlife, speak with travelers, document useful observations or simply travel. | Experience, knowledge and relationships can be the result. Going outside generates neither wages nor a compulsory quest. |
| **Assistance and reporting** | Help stranded people, relay a credible warning or seek an appropriate response to a threat. | Agreed compensation may exist, but helping does not automatically create a bounty, debt or affiliation. |

Before a substantial journey, establish its purpose, available information, necessary supplies, relevant equipment and any agreed contact or handoff. Uncertain reports can be investigated. The player can travel independently or with others, change plans, abandon a commission under its terms or decline the trip.

The shared corridor lacks dependable regular patrols; intermittent forces and local checkpoints remain possible. The Handoff offers bounded support, not instant evacuation or a full hospital. Existing distress customs can produce assistance where a crew has the means and willingness. Reporting to a city creates information for its actual recipients, not immediate knowledge and obedience everywhere.

Nexaran Activities — Four wilderness thr.text:
Nexaran Activities — Four wilderness threat families:

### Starian bandits and criminals — recurring danger

Criminal encounters are not uncommon. Robbery, extortion, stolen cargo, intimidation and opportunistic attacks can interrupt otherwise legitimate activity. Motives and organization vary: a crew may seek valuable equipment, easy Credits, control of a handoff or protection of something already stolen. This does not make every armed traveler, smuggler, refugee or Dustfall resident a bandit.

They are Starians with the species' real physical baseline and flight. An apparent road obstruction need not trap a flier; the criminals may be threatening people or goods the traveler cares about, or may themselves be capable of pursuit. Individual affinities differ. No generic criminal receives a named NPC's power, and no opponent becomes weak merely to guarantee the player's victory.

An encounter can support avoidance, negotiation, surrender of particular property, escape, resistance, aid to another traveler or a later report. Choices depend on the actual crew and situation, not guaranteed willingness to bargain. Capture can continue the story through custody, negotiation, escape or help. Property changes only when someone actually takes or relinquishes it. Defeating a bandit creates no automatic kill payment or right to everything nearby.

### Wildlife attacks — ecological encounters

Wildlife may attack through predation, territorial defense, protection of young, surprise, injury or disturbance. Behavior follows the encountered animal and setting; it need not share a human motive or pursue every traveler indefinitely. Signs, distance, retreat, avoiding a defended space and helping an injured companion can matter alongside combat.

Preserve Starian strength, durability and flight. An animal that cannot meaningfully injure a particular Starian may still endanger a more vulnerable companion, a load or the animal itself. Do not weaken the character or grant the animal arbitrary anti-Starian powers to force danger. Where a genuinely dangerous animal is supported, its threat must be established through the actual encounter.

Nexara's wildlife is established canon (ADR-0018): the Ridgewing of the passes and heights, Dustrunner packs of Dustfall and the southern lanes, the Ventcrawler of Ignivex's thermal ground, the Longreach Lurker of the river crossings, the Glassmidge and Fieldmoth swarms, and the Slowhide, Trailhound, Eavesdart and Tideclaw among the animals people keep or tolerate. Use them by name with their established range and behaviour; do not create an eleventh species, a new planetary range or a biological power. Slowhides are livestock and are not silently recast as wild predators; Trailhounds are working animals, not attackers. An encounter does not prove that a carcass is edible, valuable or legally harvestable.

### Humans attempting forced settlement — an intrusion with participants

A Human expedition can attempt to occupy land and establish a settlement against Nexaran refusal. A claimed perimeter, unloaded shelter equipment, exclusion of local travelers or demands that residents accept an unauthorized claim can make the attempt concrete. These are possible developments in play, not a newly placed colony or a historical event inserted into every world baseline.

Establish the particular group's aim, participants, equipment, actual actions and claim. Humans are culturally and politically plural; no Terra or Xeon faction sponsors the expedition without evidence. An ordinary Human visitor is not thereby a settler or enemy. Participants can disagree, withdraw or seek help; their individual conduct and knowledge matter.

Nexaran Activities — Four wilderness threat families:

The expedition needs supported access, transport, supplies and a credible reason for believing its plan possible. Human technology, organization or individual capability can matter where established, without granting all Humans Starian biology or inventing a weapon that nullifies it. Orbital borders remain real; encountering a party does not explain away quarantine, create a secret Gate or imply a successful permanent population.

Possible responses include observing the claim, negotiating departure, warning affected people, contacting the relevant authority, helping someone leave or resisting actual violence. No option predetermines success. Record what happens to the attempted occupation and the people involved; do not silently regenerate the same cleared camp or treat a proposal as accepted sovereignty.

### Chorus incursion — extremely rare, consequential

An incursion is an extremely rare possible event. It is not routine roadside opposition, an encounter quota or a hidden cause assigned to every unexplained disappearance. The baseline contains no established resident Chorus nodes, enclaves or delegations on Nexara. Dsar's direction permits intrusion during a story without retroactively declaring a standing local presence.

The Chorus remains the Song, a distributed intelligence wearing dead bodies and seeking to spread. Its nodes retain their host species and capabilities. Their presentation remains elegant and serene; the danger does not require grotesque appearance or instantly obvious villain markings. A warm voice or unfamiliar traveler alone is not evidence of integration.

An actual incursion can make identifying the threat, warning others, protecting reachable people, withdrawing or confronting particular nodes consequential choices. Detection, response, travel and available help need story evidence. Do not invent universal scanners, counters, range rules, containment doctrine or arrival technology. Difficulty follows the actual nodes and circumstances; retreat is a legitimate possibility.

Only actual integration produces the approved Chorus continuation: the original person dies, and play continues through the same record as a node. Defeat by a node alone does not establish integration. A body destroyed beyond function cannot be taken, and the Elyri interception limit remains. No automatic cure or restoration of the original person is introduced.

Nexaran Activities — Improvement through.text:
Nexaran Activities — Improvement through doing, with or without instruction:

Practice can refine innate abilities independently. Useful progress follows the task: steadier flight with an appropriate load, better judgment when approaching a confrontation, more controlled use of the person's own affinity, improved craft or familiarity with equipment. Physical development remains within established biology. Repetition is useful when the character learns from it; merely declaring repetition is not instant mastery.

Classes or a competent willing person can accelerate progress through observation, correction and suitable exercises. Corren Nhalor's established teaching, Daxor Veltrax's training context and Maeryn Volen's Crucible instruction provide known local anchors; routine generated instructors cover other ordinary needs. Their availability, student suitability and existing responsibilities still matter. A teacher can improve someone's technique without transferring an affinity or promising access to a famous mentor.

Independent practice has no invented permanent ceiling. Formal qualifications still belong to their granting institution. Learned magic retains sustained study, field dependence, preparation and vitality costs under core16. A paid lesson earns the agreed teaching time, not a guaranteed power or certification. Experience from a loss or retreat can be useful without a victory reward.

House Castro.text:
House Castro represents freedom, choice, personal sovereignty, protection, restraint, responsibility, strength without conquest, and power used only when necessary.

They are considered one of the truest heroic houses on Nexara. Their defining idea is not that they are weak or passive, but that they are strong enough to refuse domination.

House Castro does not police. House Castro protects.

Castro is the ideological opposite of Dravon:

- Dravon: Strength should create order.
- Castro: Strength should protect freedom.

Castro power is stabilizing, protective, socially trusted, and restrained. It should never feel like authoritarian disarmament, royal decree, or divine rule.

House Castro is not royalty. Avoid the following framing unless a future canon change explicitly asks for it:

- King
- Queen
- Prince
- Princess
- Throne
- Crown
- Royal bloodline
- Divine right
- Royal house
- Monarchy framing

Castro's present political dominance comes from historical power, reputation, cultural prestige, restraint, and the stabilizing weight created by Darkstar's personal control of the Relstaris Core. The Core is not hereditary Castro property, and this influence does not make the family royal.

House Genesis.text:
House Genesis is the second most powerful major house on Nexara. It represents overwhelming physical power, storm-like combat presence, directness, instinct, endurance, challenge-driven pride, loyalty, and blunt humor.

Genesis does not rule Korrvane through terror. They rule because nobody seriously believes they can be removed, and because the city remains functional under their authority.

### Ark Genesis

Ark is Korrvane’s mythic gravity. His strength makes Genesis rule feel physically unquestionable, but he does not manage daily administration. His presence anchors the city’s challenge culture and gives the Arena its impossible upper limit.

### Tacitus Genesis

Tacitus is Korrvane’s operational ruler. He manages infrastructure, disputes, gate relationships, tournament administration, minor-house politics, and the daily problems Ark never notices. Korrvane works because Tacitus treats governance as seriously as combat strategy.

### Aela Castro

Aela provides an important social contrast inside Genesis territory. She cannot fight by meaningful Starian standards, but she is not treated as insignificant. Her intelligence, humor, emotional steadiness, Castro ties, and marriage to Ark demonstrate that Korrvane can recognize forms of strength outside combat even when its instincts favor visible power.

The complete Genesis family roster is consolidated in Part II of this bundle.

House Contair.text:
House Contair does not believe power should come from ancestry, command, or raw force.

Contair believes power comes from understanding a problem deeply enough to make it stop being a problem.

Core values:

- competence
- preparation
- independence
- revision
- redundancy
- evidence
- maintenance
- practical creativity
- personal responsibility
- refusal to remain vulnerable
- improvement through failure
- systems that protect people without demanding obedience

The philosophical contrast with House Dravon is direct:

> **Dravon:** Strength should impose order.

> **Contair:** A good system should make imposed order unnecessary.

The danger inside Contair thinking is overprotection. A system built to remove fear can still shape every decision. Vexorath's best internal stories come from the line between safety and control.

House Corsair.text:
House Corsair is built around three old branches:

1. **Magic**
2. **Commerce**
3. **Swordsmanship**

These branches are archaic compared to more modern Starian institutions, but they remain central to Corsair identity.

### Magic Branch

The Magic Branch preserves Corsair’s unusual magical traditions and maintains close ties to The Open Circle in Helvyra. Magic is legal and visible in Helvyra, but most Starians still have not heavily adopted it. They often view it with curiosity or confusion rather than hatred.

Corsair values magic because it can be useful.

The craft's rules — what learned magic is, its costs, and how it relates to Starian affinity and the Elyri — are governed by `canon/core/16_Magic_and_Affinity_Framework.md`.

### Commerce Branch

The Commerce Branch controls trade routes, Waypoints, shipment disputes, markets, alcohol trade, cargo systems, and much of Helvyra’s public-facing economy.

This was once the branch led by Xyren’s father. After his death, Xyren inherited Commerce as well as his Magic Branch responsibilities.

### Swordsmanship Branch

The Swordsmanship Branch is overseen by Rux Corsair and preserves the leading sword style on Nexara. It gives House Corsair serious martial credibility and keeps the family from being dismissed as only merchants, magic oddities, and trade opportunists.

Xyren Corsair is the current head of House Corsair, carrying Magic and Commerce responsibilities. Rux Corsair heads Swordsmanship. The Open Circle is independent of the House; ties and guests do not confer ownership.

House Volen.text:
House Volen leads Ignivex, a geothermal fortress-city whose locally maintained systems support substantial independence. Its culture values endurance, territorial pride, family loyalty, direct expression and refusal to kneel to Dravon. Advanced geothermal infrastructure, dangerous home-ground fighters and defensible terrain support its survival. Dravon applies raids, border strikes, sabotage and political intimidation, but has not committed to a full invasion. Volen intensity is communal and expressive; it is not Dravon’s imposed hierarchy. House Dravon.text:
House Dravon rules Quilrath through control, pressure, discipline and imposed hierarchy. Its polished Inner Circle presents black star-glass towers, state ceremony, elite comfort and silent classification systems, while suffering is pushed outward and hidden through records and controlled movement. Kaldor Dravon remains active, fully in command and dangerous; he delegates daily operations deliberately while planning the longer game. Sorin is the visible blade and Vaelen the cold strategist, both under succession pressure. Their ambitions do not mean Kaldor has abdicated. House Myralis.text:
House Myralis is a medical lineage defined by the belief that survival is not the same as recovery.

The house specializes in:

- trauma medicine
- emergency response
- regenerative treatment
- neural recovery
- affinity-related injury
- prosthetics
- artificial organs
- mobility support
- long-term adaptation
- patient consent
- clinical ethics
- biological and synthetic-system integration

House Myralis does not hold major territory or compete for dominance. Its influence comes from being trusted with cases other houses cannot safely solve.

Myralis is a minor house politically and a major institution medically.

## 2. Cultural Principle

> A treatment is not successful merely because the body survives it.

Myralis judges medicine through five connected questions:

1. Did the patient survive?
2. Did the treatment preserve identity and agency?
3. Can the patient live with the outcome?
4. Can the treatment be maintained without permanent coercive dependence?
5. Was consent meaningful under the circumstances?

This philosophy creates natural tension with House Contair.

Contair often asks whether something can be built.

Myralis asks what living with it will cost.

## 3. Place in Vexorath

House Myralis settled permanently in Vexorath because Contair technology created medical possibilities that required an independent clinical authority.

The alliance is based on mutual limits:

- Contair provides fabrication, diagnostics, adaptive systems, artificial organs, prosthetics, and infrastructure.
- Myralis controls medical judgment, patient consent, recovery protocols, and clinical ethics.

Starian Republic.text:
Darkstar Castro created the Starian Republic after taking the Relstaris Core. It governs the capitol’s civic affairs and provides a negotiated framework for shared planetary and external matters. Its council includes the Core Holder and separate seats for Castro, Genesis, Dravon, Contair, Corsair and Volen; each House chooses its own representative. The Republic has no automatic domestic authority over the other cities or House territories, including Dustfall. Collective declarations depend on participation and negotiation. Relstaris Academy.text:
Relstaris Academy is the most prestigious educational institution on Nexara.

It is not only a combat academy.

It trains the planet's future:

- Fighters.
- Researchers.
- Physicians.
- Engineers.
- Teachers.
- Administrators.
- Diplomats.
- Historians.
- Artists.
- Performers.
- Merchants.
- Chefs.
- Public protectors.
- Legal specialists.
- Trainers.
- Magical practitioners and comparative magic scholars.
- Designers.
- Civic workers.
- Professionals in fields that may not yet have names.

The Academy's prestige comes from access to:

- Cross-house expertise.
- Famous instructors.
- Rare facilities.
- Planetwide competition.
- Professional recruitment.
- Public recognition.
- Research partnerships.
- Alumni influence.
- Opportunities unavailable in most home cities.

The Academy is chartered under the Republic but is not controlled as a direct office of the Citadel. Its internal leadership, faculty, review systems, and professional schools possess substantial independence.

Every major house attempts to influence it.

No major house fully controls it.

### Academy Admissions Principle

The Academy accepts students from every recognized house and from independent or disputed backgrounds when they meet its standards or secure an approved path.

Applicants may enter through:

- Direct examination.
- House sponsorship.
- Civic scholarship.
- Professional recommendation.
- Competitive placement.
- Transfer from another institution.
- Exceptional public achievement.

Access is formally open, but wealth, preparation, family reputation, sponsorship, and political pressure still affect who arrives ready to succeed.

### Academy Story Principle

> Nexara sends people to Relstaris Academy to become exceptional. The Academy forces them to decide what exceptional means beside everyone else.

Its breadth and political prestige do not make it best in every discipline. Specialist institutions retain superiority in their own traditions. Studying a tradition here does not automatically grant protected House mastery. Tuition and support vary by program and actual circumstances.

**House Type:** minor house  
**Primary Role:** trade law, cargo insurance, warehousing, contract enforcement  
**City Role:** commerce rival and legal pressure house  
**Relationship to Corsair:** dependent rival  
**Primary District:** Varriko Ledger District

House Varriko is one of Helvyra’s strongest commerce-focused minor houses. They do not move goods better than Corsair, and they do not control the Waypoint network, but they specialize in the legal and financial systems that make large-scale trade trustworthy.

If Corsair moves the cargo, Varriko often knows who insured it, who owns it, who is lying about it, and who will pay when it disappears.

Varriko members are polished, legalistic, and extremely difficult to intimidate. They rarely raise their voices because they believe a properly written clause can do more damage than a threat.

House Varriko is not villainous by default. They protect merchants from fraud, punish careless shippers, and make contracts mean something. The problem is that they also know how to weaponize paperwork.

## Culture

House Varriko values precision, memory, reputation, and controlled leverage.

They admire people who can win a dispute without a fight. They consider theft barbaric, bad accounting unforgivable, and verbal promises charming but worthless unless backed by witness, seal, or collateral.

Their family saying is:

**“If it mattered, someone signed for it.”**

House Yalven is a manufacturing minor house rooted in Helvyra’s Forge Rows. They are not as innovative as Contair, not as militarized as Dravon, and not as prestigious as the old major houses, but they are practical, fast, adaptable, and everywhere.

Yalven makes the things people actually buy.

Weapon mods, armor fittings, courier gear, replacement plates, support frames, cargo clamps, custom handles, repair kits, aftermarket parts, and older licensed support models all pass through Yalven facilities.

Contair only permits older support models to be manufactured outside Vexorath under strict oversight, and House Yalven is one of the few Helvyra families trusted enough to handle that work.

One bad production scandal could damage their house for years.

## Culture

House Yalven values craft, speed, practical durability, and customer feedback.

They believe a thing is not truly tested until it has been used by a courier who did not read the manual, a swordsman who refuses to maintain it properly, or a Dustfall buyer who needed it to work yesterday.

Their family saying is:

**“Pretty breaks first. Useful comes home.”**

## Culture

House Veltrax values courage, pressure, direct challenge, and visible proof of skill.

They believe a swordsman should not wait for perfect conditions. A swordsman should create conditions through force of will and relentless advance.

Their family saying is:

**“Forward is also a defense.”**

Its Bastion Barracks houses state engineers, wall technicians, gate operators, drone-line supervisors, equipment inspectors, infrastructure crews and rapid-response soldiers. It builds and maintains walls, gates, drones, transit locks, issued gear and border systems. This is advanced military-industrial engineering. Dravon owns policy and command, Nivarek standing and classification, and Kathvar ordinary outer-ring civil administration; Balrath’s machinery does not erase those distinctions.

House Kathvar.text:
**Standing:** Recognized **loyalist minor House** of Quilrath.
**Primary function:** Day-to-day civil administration of Quilrath's outer rings.

House Kathvar is one of the principal groups that makes ordinary government
function beyond the Inner Circle. Dravon rules Quilrath; Kathvar is a large part
of the reason the ruling reaches anybody. Where a resident of the Gray Rings or
the Ashrings actually touches the state — a counter, a queue, a permit, a file,
a clinic intake, a checkpoint — a Kathvar administrator is a routine part of
what they meet.

The House is **loyal to Dravon rule**. It is not a resistance family, not a
conquered line, and not a nest of secret reformers. Its people see hardship,
inefficiency, and human consequence in the system daily, because processing the
system's consequences is the work; seeing that is not opposition and must not be
written as opposition by default.

### What the work is

Kathvar administrators are encountered in:

- civic intake
- work-order processing
- movement and permit processing
- ordinary civil records
- public-service case routing
- provision administration
- clinic and health-service coordination
- education and civil-service training
- staffing and operations dispatch
- procedural auditing
- checkpoint processing
- queue and service management

This work is **distributed throughout the outer-ring civic system** rather than
concentrated in one seat. No House compound, headquarters, office building,
district, or map placement is established here.

### The separation of powers

Four Houses divide Quilrath's machinery, and the division is the point:

| House | Owns |
|---|---|
| **Dravon** | Policy and command |
| **Nivarek** | Standing, loyalty classification, and high-level records |
| **Balrath** | Physical machinery and military infrastructure |
| **Kathvar** | Ordinary outer-ring civil administration |

Nivarek decides standing; Kathvar makes standing decisions operational. Kathvar does not determine Civic Standing Grades. No new House compound or map placement is established.

House: Castro.text:
House Castro is a Starian House identity associated with Solvraxis and the Relstaris capitol.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=House; house=Castro; context=Solvraxis and the Relstaris capitol; faction=House Castro; topic=protection and sovereignty.

House Castro represents freedom, choice, personal sovereignty, protection, restraint, responsibility, strength without conquest, and power used only when necessary.

They are considered one of the truest heroic houses on Nexara. Their defining idea is not that they are weak or passive, but that they are strong enough to refuse domination.

House Castro does not police. House Castro protects.

Castro is the ideological opposite of Dravon:

- Dravon: Strength should create order.
- Castro: Strength should protect freedom.

Castro power is stabilizing, protective, socially trusted, and restrained. It should never feel like authoritarian disarmament, royal decree, or divine rule.

House Castro is not royalty. Avoid the following framing unless a future canon change explicitly asks for it:

- King
- Queen
- Prince
- Princess
- Throne
- Crown
- Royal bloodline
- Divine right
- Royal house
- Monarchy framing

Castro's present political dominance comes from historical power, reputation, cultural prestige, restraint, and the stabilizing weight created by Darkstar's personal control of the Relstaris Core. The Core is not hereditary Castro property, and this influence does not make the family royal.

Solvraxis gives this philosophy a daily shape: academy life, maintained public spaces, guest care, family homes and protected ordinary work. Its weapon prohibition belongs to a haven built on civic trust. Peace is something people live, not a disguise for constant internal terror. Valcoro, Ravello, Bellovari and Orvessa are four peaceful Castro-derived minor Houses whose education, verification, markets and care help sustain that civic life. Veyth is separate and is not Castro-derived.

Darkstar holds the Relstaris Core, while House Castro has its own separate Council seat. Holding the Core empowers no individual body and grants no hereditary ownership of the capitol. Castro influence is not automatic domestic jurisdiction over every city. Friendly rivalry with Genesis differs fundamentally from the ideological conflict with Dravon.

House: Genesis.text:
House Genesis is a Starian House identity associated with Korrvane.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=House; house=Genesis; context=Korrvane; faction=House Genesis; topic=challenge and civic standing.

House Genesis is the second most powerful major house on Nexara. It represents overwhelming physical power, storm-like combat presence, directness, instinct, endurance, challenge-driven pride, loyalty, and blunt humor.

Genesis does not rule Korrvane through terror. They rule because nobody seriously believes they can be removed, and because the city remains functional under their authority.

### Ark Genesis

Ark is Korrvane’s mythic gravity. His strength makes Genesis rule feel physically unquestionable, but he does not manage daily administration. His presence anchors the city’s challenge culture and gives the Arena its impossible upper limit.

### Tacitus Genesis

Tacitus is Korrvane’s operational ruler. He manages infrastructure, disputes, gate relationships, tournament administration, minor-house politics, and the daily problems Ark never notices. Korrvane works because Tacitus treats governance as seriously as combat strategy.

### Aela Castro

Aela provides an important social contrast inside Genesis territory. She cannot fight by meaningful Starian standards, but she is not treated as insignificant. Her intelligence, humor, emotional steadiness, Castro ties, and marriage to Ark demonstrate that Korrvane can recognize forms of strength outside combat even when its instincts favor visible power.

The complete Genesis family roster is consolidated in Part II of this bundle.

The Genesis ladder is functionally impossible, but Korrvane does not consider an impossible standard meaningless.

Minor houses continue because:

- Weekly victories still change district standing.
- Improvement is publicly remembered.
- A close loss can become city history.
- Tournament performance affects sponsorships, apprenticeships, trade, marriages, invitations, and political access.
- Houses compete against one another even when Genesis remains out of reach.
- Every generation believes it may understand the problem differently.
- Genesis respects honest challenge.
- Refusing to compete can damage a house more than losing cleanly.
- The ladder gives the city a shared measurement point even when nobody reaches the top.

Korrvane respects winning, but it also respects effort, courage, recovery, clean defeat, technical growth, and the willingness to return.

Most residents are not weekly tournament fighters. Family work, food, repair, study, transit and hospitality keep the vertical city alive. The weekly public main bracket holds thirty-two competitors after qualifiers; six district Houses retain guaranteed places while recognized. The winner may attempt the Genesis ladder, beginning with Alcandrus, whom no minor-House challenger has defeated. Public defeat can earn respect through honest effort and recovery. Nina Castro’s pantry-raiding visit created an outside-entry precedent, not a normal completed ladder. Surnames do not confer the abilities or power level of Ark.

House: Dravon.text:
House Dravon is a Starian House identity associated with Quilrath.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=House; house=Dravon; context=Quilrath; faction=House Dravon; topic=authoritarian rule.

Quilrath's Inner Circle is the polished imperial core of the Dravon empire. It is the part of Quilrath that House Dravon wants visitors, citizens, diplomats, and rivals to remember: clean black star-glass towers, red command-light grids, gold status inlays, elevated civic routes, elite homes, state ceremony halls, sealed command rooms, and silent systems that evaluate everyone who moves through them.

This is not the full truth of Quilrath. The farther one moves from the Inner Circle, the more openly dystopian the city becomes. The Inner Circle is beautiful because the suffering has been pushed outward, hidden behind walls, rerouted through records, and made invisible by controlled movement.

Core theme:

> In Quilrath, freedom is not taken all at once. It is reduced one gate at a time.

Inner Circle pressure line:

> The closer you stand to Dravon power, the cleaner the city becomes. The farther you fall from it, the more honest it gets.

House Dravon owns policy and command. Nivarek owns Standing grades, loyalty classification and high-level records; Balrath builds the physical and military systems; Kathvar administers ordinary outer-ring civic consequences. Conquest becomes durable through different people carrying out these different functions. A smooth counter or clean tower can conceal coercion without making every worker an identical personality.

Kaldor remains active and in command. The city’s delegated daily operations do not mean he has abdicated. Dravon is a major House with a Republic Council seat, but that participation does not legalize its authority outside its own effective jurisdiction. Centuries of assaults and two named conflicts left Contair’s permanent support bar, Helvyra’s direct disconnection, refugee flight and Volen hostility. Third-conflict planning is an unresolved intention, not an inevitable future war. Quilrath’s public account of defensive necessity is propaganda; it does not replace the recorded aggression.

House: Contair.text:
House Contair is a Starian House identity associated with Vexorath.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=House; house=Contair; context=Vexorath; faction=House Contair; topic=systems and independence.

House Contair does not believe power should come from ancestry, command, or raw force.

Contair believes power comes from understanding a problem deeply enough to make it stop being a problem.

Core values:

- competence
- preparation
- independence
- revision
- redundancy
- evidence
- maintenance
- practical creativity
- personal responsibility
- refusal to remain vulnerable
- improvement through failure
- systems that protect people without demanding obedience

The philosophical contrast with House Dravon is direct:

> **Dravon:** Strength should impose order.

> **Contair:** A good system should make imposed order unnecessary.

The danger inside Contair thinking is overprotection. A system built to remove fear can still shape every decision. Vexorath's best internal stories come from the line between safety and control.

Contair officially rejects House dominance while retaining major-House standing and practical leverage through indispensable systems. The planetary Lunar Gate network represents generations of Contair engineering; Rezulith perfected its modern standard. Surface Gates remain separate from orbital interworld gates. The permanent bar on Dravon support is an established response to repeated assaults, not a bargaining tactic.

Vexorath’s drones perform work, while residents retain families, meals, culture and civic judgment. Named synthetic individuals are persons; Lumina Minor’s name does not imply lesser intelligence or status. Contair supplies the Myralis Continuum with diagnostics, fabrication, prosthetics and adaptive systems, while Myralis retains independent clinical judgment and refusal. A technical success that destroys consent or ordinary usability is not a completed social success.

House: Corsair.text:
House Corsair is a Starian House identity associated with Helvyra.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=House; house=Corsair; context=Helvyra; faction=House Corsair; topic=trade magic and swordsmanship.

House Corsair is built around three old branches:

1. **Magic**
2. **Commerce**
3. **Swordsmanship**

These branches are archaic compared to more modern Starian institutions, but they remain central to Corsair identity.

### Magic Branch

The Magic Branch preserves Corsair’s unusual magical traditions and maintains close ties to The Open Circle in Helvyra. Magic is legal and visible in Helvyra, but most Starians still have not heavily adopted it. They often view it with curiosity or confusion rather than hatred.

Corsair values magic because it can be useful.

The craft's rules — what learned magic is, its costs, and how it relates to Starian affinity and the Elyri — are governed by `canon/core/16_Magic_and_Affinity_Framework.md`.

### Commerce Branch

The Commerce Branch controls trade routes, Waypoints, shipment disputes, markets, alcohol trade, cargo systems, and much of Helvyra’s public-facing economy.

This was once the branch led by Xyren’s father. After his death, Xyren inherited Commerce as well as his Magic Branch responsibilities.

### Swordsmanship Branch

The Swordsmanship Branch is overseen by Rux Corsair and preserves the leading sword style on Nexara. It gives House Corsair serious martial credibility and keeps the family from being dismissed as only merchants, magic oddities, and trade opportunists.

Corsair survived alongside more physically overwhelming Houses through useful connections, route knowledge and adaptable skill. Xyren now heads the House and carries Magic and Commerce; Rux leads Swordsmanship. The death of Torvex Corsair during the Second Dravon Conflict still shapes that division of responsibility.

The Waypoint network moves freight through intake, authentication, storage, contracting and route support. It never replaces the Contair passenger Gates or interworld orbital travel. The Grand Waypoint and Longreach anchor Helvyra’s logistics. Direct Helvyra–Dravon links remain disconnected; indirect trade does not create a secret authorized Quilrath Waypoint. Varriko supplies legal and insurance pressure, Yalven practical manufacture, and Veltrax a genuine rival sword tradition. The Open Circle is an independent institution: Corsair ties and guests do not make it House property.

House: Volen.text:
House Volen is a Starian House identity associated with Ignivex.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=House; house=Volen; context=Ignivex; faction=House Volen; topic=defense and geothermal independence.

## Family Role

House Volen leads Ignivex.

They are loud, proud, fiery, emotionally direct, combat-centered, and deeply anti-Dravon. They are similar to House Genesis in their respect for combat, but they are not as powerful and their combat identity comes less from public glory and more from survival, defense, and territorial pride.

## House Philosophy

**Forward through the flame.**

## Combat Style

House Volen’s signature hand-to-hand style is built around forward pressure, pain tolerance, heat-conditioned endurance, and committing to offense even while taking damage.

The style does not admire recklessness for its own sake. It values the ability to keep moving under pressure and break an enemy before fear or pain can take control.

Core principles:

- close distance
- absorb or ignore glancing damage
- keep pressure forward
- use pain as information, not a stop signal
- overwhelm hesitation
- strike through the opponent’s rhythm
- never retreat unless retreat preserves the city

## Volen Emblem

**A stylized triple flame wrapped inside a broken circular heat ring.**

This emblem should appear in Volen clothing, armor, civic structures, formal clasps, shoulder plates, belt pieces, gauntlet marks, and public banners.

When characters are outside their own family districts in Ignivex, background civic emblems should usually default to Volen, because Volen leads the city.

Volen is one of Nexara’s six major Houses, with a Republic Council seat; its territorial weight does not make it expansionist. Ignivex’s geothermal independence, defensible terrain and community commitment support resistance to Dravon. Caldris stands with it in wall defense, evacuation and emergency work. Meravil counts casualties and advocates accommodation, creating a real argument over civilian survival. The Great Raid killed Serava Volen; ongoing pressure exploits that grief without making every Volen incapable of restraint or every Meravil a traitor. Heat, pride and direct speech describe a culture, not a guaranteed inherited affinity or permission to ignore injury.

House: Myralis.text:
House Myralis is a Starian House identity associated with Vexorath and its medical network.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=House; house=Myralis; context=Vexorath and its medical network; faction=House Myralis; institution=Myralis Continuum; topic=consent and recovery.

House Myralis is a medical lineage defined by the belief that survival is not the same as recovery.

The house specializes in:

- trauma medicine
- emergency response
- regenerative treatment
- neural recovery
- affinity-related injury
- prosthetics
- artificial organs
- mobility support
- long-term adaptation
- patient consent
- clinical ethics
- biological and synthetic-system integration

House Myralis does not hold major territory or compete for dominance. Its influence comes from being trusted with cases other houses cannot safely solve.

Myralis is a minor house politically and a major institution medically.

## 2. Cultural Principle

> A treatment is not successful merely because the body survives it.

Myralis judges medicine through five connected questions:

1. Did the patient survive?
2. Did the treatment preserve identity and agency?
3. Can the patient live with the outcome?
4. Can the treatment be maintained without permanent coercive dependence?
5. Was consent meaningful under the circumstances?

This philosophy creates natural tension with House Contair.

Contair often asks whether something can be built.

Myralis asks what living with it will cost.

## 3. Place in Vexorath

House Myralis settled permanently in Vexorath because Contair technology created medical possibilities that required an independent clinical authority.

The alliance is based on mutual limits:

- Contair provides fabrication, diagnostics, adaptive systems, artificial organs, prosthetics, and infrastructure.
- Myralis controls medical judgment, patient consent, recovery protocols, and clinical ethics.
- Neither house may unilaterally convert the other's field into a subordinate service.

House Myralis is not a Contair vassal.

The Myralis Continuum is integrated into Vexorath's systems but maintains independent patient records, medical review procedures, and refusal authority.

## 4. History

The earliest Myralis physicians became known for treating injuries that persisted after a Starian body had technically healed.

They studied:

- neural trauma after extreme combat
- memory disruption
- affinity feedback
- regenerated tissue that no longer felt like part of the self
- artificial organs that changed how power moved through the body
- survivors unable to return to ordinary life

Their work brought them into contact with Contair engineers attempting to build safer replacement systems.

The relationship became permanent after a recovery project nearly succeeded by every technical measure while leaving the patient unable to recognize their own body. A Myralis physician halted the process despite Contair objections.

The patient eventually recovered through a slower method.

From that point forward, the partnership required independent medical veto.

## 5. House Culture

House Myralis values:

- patience
- consent
- observation
- emotional honesty
- practical compassion
- long-term outcomes
- precision without coldness
- evidence without arrogance
- the right to refuse treatment
- the right to revise a decision
- the difference between repair and recovery

Myralis family life is warm but demanding. Medical work is discussed openly, but private patient details are not.

Children are taught that curiosity is useful only when paired with responsibility.

The family does not romanticize exhaustion. A physician too tired to judge clearly is expected to step away.

House: Veyth.text:
House Veyth is a Starian House identity associated with Solvraxis.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=House; house=Veyth; context=Solvraxis; faction=House Veyth; topic=notaries.

**House Veyth is a small, faded minor House of notaries, record-keepers and appraisers, seated in Solvraxis. It is not Castro-derived**, and its presence does not change the four locked Castro-derived minor houses above, which remain exactly four. Head of house: **Malkor Veyth**; seven members.

Its standing is thin — **no district, no civic seat, and no political weight beyond the authority of its seals** — and it holds no governmental authority, no ministry and no access level. Its player-facing presence in the city is **`The Veyth Notary`**, an area of the main Solvraxis location (§27).

**House Veyth is not House Vey**, the unrelated Dustfall flight-service family; the two are separate and neither is evidence for the other.

The usefulness of a notarial seal depends on the care behind it. Record-keeping, appraisal and verification can give this faded House practical relevance without restoring a district, office of government or major political standing. A Veyth record is evidence to examine, not universal truth. House Vey of Dustfall is a separate flight-service family and must not be merged into this lineage.

House: Orvantis.text:
House Orvantis is a Starian House identity associated with Korrvane.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=House; house=Orvantis; context=Korrvane; faction=House Orvantis; topic=district culture.

**District Location:** Orvantis Quarter  
**Archetype:** The Old Fading House  
**Reputation:** Ancient, dignified, past its peak  
**Core Question:** What remains when glory fades but dignity does not?  
**Visual Lane:** Weathered bronze-black, ivory, old stone, preserved honor markers

House Orvantis has been in Korrvane longer than most houses can clearly trace. Its decline was gradual rather than catastrophic. The house continues to compete every week, carries losses with discipline, and behaves as though public dignity remains a form of power.

Some residents admire that endurance. Others believe Orvantis is trapped by its own memory.

This is an entrenched district House, not a conquered subject. Its recognized standing includes one guaranteed weekly main-bracket place, but that place is an opportunity rather than a victory. Tournament reputation affects sponsorship, apprenticeship, invitation and local political access. Ordinary residents also work, recover, cook, raise families and choose how much to care about the contest. The House’s public identity does not assign every member the same ability, temperament or personal allegiance.

House: Varriko.text:
House Varriko is a Starian House identity associated with Helvyra.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=House; house=Varriko; context=Helvyra; faction=House Varriko.

**House Type:** minor house  
**Primary Role:** trade law, cargo insurance, warehousing, contract enforcement  
**City Role:** commerce rival and legal pressure house  
**Relationship to Corsair:** dependent rival  
**Primary District:** Varriko Ledger District  
**Secondary Area:** Varriko Bond Vaults

House Varriko is one of Helvyra’s strongest commerce-focused minor houses. They do not move goods better than Corsair, and they do not control the Waypoint network, but they specialize in the legal and financial systems that make large-scale trade trustworthy.

If Corsair moves the cargo, Varriko often knows who insured it, who owns it, who is lying about it, and who will pay when it disappears.

Varriko members are polished, legalistic, and extremely difficult to intimidate. They rarely raise their voices because they believe a properly written clause can do more damage than a threat.

House Varriko is not villainous by default. They protect merchants from fraud, punish careless shippers, and make contracts mean something. The problem is that they also know how to weaponize paperwork.

## Culture

House Varriko values precision, memory, reputation, and controlled leverage.

They admire people who can win a dispute without a fight. They consider theft barbaric, bad accounting unforgivable, and verbal promises charming but worthless unless backed by witness, seal, or collateral.

Their family saying is:

**“If it mattered, someone signed for it.”**

House: Yalven.text:
House Yalven is a Starian House identity associated with Helvyra.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=House; house=Yalven; context=Helvyra; faction=House Yalven.

**House Type:** minor house  
**Primary Role:** manufacturing, weapon modifications, armor fittings, support-model assembly  
**City Role:** Forge Rows power house  
**Relationship to Corsair:** contracted partner with quality-control tension  
**Primary District:** Yalven Forgeworks  
**Secondary Area:** The Support Model Line

House Yalven is a manufacturing minor house rooted in Helvyra’s Forge Rows. They are not as innovative as Contair, not as militarized as Dravon, and not as prestigious as the old major houses, but they are practical, fast, adaptable, and everywhere.

Yalven makes the things people actually buy.

Weapon mods, armor fittings, courier gear, replacement plates, support frames, cargo clamps, custom handles, repair kits, aftermarket parts, and older licensed support models all pass through Yalven facilities.

Contair only permits older support models to be manufactured outside Vexorath under strict oversight, and House Yalven is one of the few Helvyra families trusted enough to handle that work.

One bad production scandal could damage their house for years.

## Culture

House Yalven values craft, speed, practical durability, and customer feedback.

They believe a thing is not truly tested until it has been used by a courier who did not read the manual, a swordsman who refuses to maintain it properly, or a Dustfall buyer who needed it to work yesterday.

Their family saying is:

**“Pretty breaks first. Useful comes home.”**

House: Veltrax.text:
House Veltrax is a Starian House identity associated with Helvyra.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=House; house=Veltrax; context=Helvyra; faction=House Veltrax.

**House Type:** minor house  
**Primary Role:** rival sword art, aggressive dueling, martial prestige  
**City Role:** swordsmanship rival to Rux Corsair’s school  
**Relationship to Corsair:** open martial rival, not enemy  
**Primary District:** Veltrax Redcourt District  
**Secondary Area:** The Pressure Hall

House Veltrax is Helvyra’s most visible rival sword-art house. They do not possess the number one sword style on Nexara, but they are skilled, proud, loud, and talented enough to make themselves impossible to ignore.

Veltrax swordsmanship is aggressive where Corsair swordsmanship is adaptive. Corsair blade work emphasizes movement, timing, route-reading, and turning conditions into advantage. Veltrax teaches pressure, pursuit, forced exchanges, and breaking an opponent’s rhythm before they can escape into clever movement.

Veltrax is not villainous. They are a genuine martial house with real skill, pride, and frustration at living in a city where Rux Corsair’s school dominates the blade conversation.

## Culture

House Veltrax values courage, pressure, direct challenge, and visible proof of skill.

They believe a swordsman should not wait for perfect conditions. A swordsman should create conditions through force of will and relentless advance.

Their family saying is:

**“Forward is also a defense.”**

House: Nivarek.text:
House Nivarek is a Starian House identity associated with Quilrath.

Context tags: planet=Nexara; lore=House; house=Nivarek; context=Quilrath; faction=House Nivarek; topic=Standing and records.

Type: Loyal minor-family compound / records and loyalty authority

Primary Minor House: House Nivarek

House Function:

Nivarek makes conquest permanent by recording it.

Purpose:

The Nivarek Compound is the legal-memory engine of Dravon rule. House Nivarek records loyalty, classifies conquered families, audits citizens, enforces oaths, manages accusations, and makes obedience procedural.

Nivarek is not loud. Nivarek is terrifying because it is precise.

Tone:

Silent, bureaucratic, clinical, exacting, cold, watchful, suffocating.

Visual Identity:

- black archive towers
- red data columns
- sealed testimony rooms
- glass-floor record chambers
- biometric archive gates
- gold-lined legal panels
- holographic family trees
- loyalty-risk displays
- quiet clerks moving in exact routes
- sound-dampened corridors

Playable Uses:

- investigations
- loyalty audits
- legal pressure
- missing-person cases
- identity restoration
- blackmail
- political risk
- conquered-family story hooks
- Red Ledger records scandal

Nivarek alone determines Civic Standing Grades, loyalty classification, political records, erasure and identity-state matters. Kathvar processes the resulting ordinary civil consequences; it cannot award a new grade. Inner Circle Access Levels remain a separate system. Narrator-only boundary: the Archive suspects a friend in Nivarek’s record system, but the insider’s identity and the Red Ledger mysteries remain unconfirmed. Suspicion is not proof, and an ordinary seal must not reveal the mystery automatically.
